digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, ticket reconciliation, CLI command registry, Jira lifecycle reconciliation
propositions: Five recovered approved recovery proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) from 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs mapping architectural intent, prior ADR/ticket decisions, behavioral tests, extraction seams, migration hazards, and remaining maintainer-only choices before implementation stories begin.

RP-02 owns ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary: the durable tombstone is the retirement intent, recovery removes the live forward/reverse pair only when tombstone/forward/reverse identities exactly agree, repeat is a no-op, ambiguity or replacement failure safety-aborts, and this is an approved behavior delta from prior behavior of reloading identity as simultaneously live and retired.

RP-03 establishes singular retry ownership with a two-level pattern: concrete adapters own request-replay loops, timeouts, SDK configuration, and error decoding; the backend-neutral reconciler owns operation intent/postconditions, commit_unknown, re-observation, deferral, finite-pass fuse, and outcome accountability; maximum 3 physical wire invocations per logical postcondition, 15 seconds cumulative sleep, authoritative Retry-After lower bounds with retry_not_before deferral, and three-consecutive exhausted scope fuse across at least 2 tickets.

RP-04 supplies the canonical operation-authority snapshot consumed by RP-03 and RP-05 with explicit CLI-over-environment precedence, fail-closed malformed-config, non-secret subprocess envelope, central defaults, and removal of Cloud's adapter-local fallback.

RP-05 implements a stdlib-only lazy command registry where canonical package-data help for every visible top-level command resolves before operation-snapshot composition, config materialization, store mount, and handler execution; exact aliases reuse canonical help, compatibility shims retain alias-specific help naming replacements, hidden bridge-status resolves explicit help but remains undiscoverable, and purge-bridge remains unknown.

RP-06 finalizes effective-policy discovery with Option-B runtime failure policy: after local operation exhaustion preserve completed successes, continue independent units, skip dependency-blocked units with provenance, record failed units as coverage gaps unsigned INDETERMINATE unless actual blocking findings take precedence, and require explicit review-plan --retry to resume only missing content-identical calls with fresh budget authorization.
